title: Lightstack Helm chart values
description: Input contract for the Lightstack chart. helm install/upgrade/lint/template validate values against this schema and reject structurally invalid input before any workload is created. See charts/lightstack/CONTRACT.md. Cross-field conditional requirements (e.g. credentials required unless an existing secret; the teardown image required under delete) are enforced at render time, not here.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names (default: the chart name).

image.description: Container image for the Lightstack binary.

repository.description: REQUIRED image repository, e.g. ghcr.io/your-org/lightstack. No default — the chart pulls no implicit image (FR-018).

tag.description: Image tag — THE product version input. Selects which Lightstack build deploys; defaults to Chart.appVersion when empty. Open-ended (registry-defined), so no enum.

replicaCount.description: Single-node stub replicas. Real mode auto-pins to 1 (advisory).

database.description: Database reference. External PostgreSQL (the chart deploys no database, FR-006), or single-node SQLite on a node-local hostPath. Provide url OR existingSecret (existingSecret is PostgreSQL-only).

url.description: Database URL; its scheme selects the backend. PostgreSQL: postgres://user:pw@host:5432/lightstack?sslmode=disable. SQLite (single node): sqlite:///<absolute path under realMode.hostStoragePath>, e.g. sqlite:///var/lib/lightstack/db/lightstack.db — the chart then renders a hostPath db directory (no PVC), strategy Recreate, and requires a node pin; a SQLite URL cannot be combined with existingSecret or secrets.existingSecret. Required unless existingSecret is set (enforced at render time).

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the DB URL (alternative to url, PostgreSQL only); injected as LIGHTSTACK_DB_URL.

existingSecretKey.description: Key within existingSecret that holds the URL (default: url).

secrets.description: Sensitive values. Required unless secrets.existingSecret is supplied. Validation is PRESENCE-ONLY — strength is not enforced; existingSecret-provided values are never schema-validated.

jwtSecret.description: Token signing secret. Required unless existingSecret (render-time). No strength check — use a strong random value (guidance only).

adminPassword.description: Admin password. Required unless existingSecret (render-time). No strength check.

existingSecret.description: Operator-pre-rendered Secret with a lightstack.yaml key (GitOps).

endpointHost.description: Advertised catalog host (LIGHTSTACK_ENDPOINT_HOST). REQUIRED for external consumers — the Keystone service catalog advertises this host; unset, it advertises localhost (unusable off-node). Empty = in-cluster only.

rgwCompatTenantIds.description: Render project IDs in OpenStack's dash-free RGW-safe form in token responses.

service.description: Front-door Service (the six API ports; metadata is node-local).

tls.description: Optional TLS at the exposure layer; sets the https catalog scheme.

certManagerIssuer.description: cert-manager (Cluster)Issuer name to auto-provision the cert.

nova.description: Compute service mode, console and reconciler settings.

consoleProxyBaseUrl.description: Browser-reachable ORIGIN of the console proxy (scheme://host:port, no path). Empty derives it from the request. Pattern-checked because Lightstack appends the client page and token itself, and the binary refuses to start on anything more than an origin: without it, a path such as /vnc_auto.html (the form upstream Nova's novncproxy_base_url takes) installs cleanly and then crash-loops the pod.

consoleTokenTtl.description: Console token lifetime (Go duration, e.g. 10m). Effective ceiling is this plus consoleReconcileInterval. Pattern-checked because these render into lightstack.yaml and are parsed as time.Duration: an unparseable value is a hard LoadConfig error (not a defaulted one), so without it a typo installs cleanly and then crash-loops the pod. The repeated group accepts compound forms like 1h30m, which time.ParseDuration also accepts.

consoleReconcileInterval.description: How often expired console tokens are reaped. This is what enforces expiry — the proxy performs no expiry check. Same duration pattern as consoleTokenTtl.

stateReconcileInterval.description: How often the recorded run state of real-mode instances is reconciled against the hypervisor (SPEC-025 FR-024b). Bounds how stale a server's reported state can be for drift Lightstack did not cause; state changes Lightstack makes itself are persisted immediately and need no sweep. Go duration (e.g. 30s). Pattern-checked because these render into lightstack.yaml and are parsed as time.Duration: an unparseable value is a hard LoadConfig error (not a defaulted one), so without it a typo installs cleanly and then crash-loops the pod. The repeated group accepts compound forms like 1h30m, which time.ParseDuration also accepts. A non-positive value is clamped to 30s rather than honored, since 0 would mean a busy loop.

instanceActionRetention.description: How long a server's action records are kept after the server is deleted (SPEC-025 FR-042a). Deletion does not remove the history, matching upstream, so this is what bounds its growth. Records of a server that still exists are never reclaimed regardless of age. A non-positive value is clamped to the 90-day default rather than honored, since 0 would mean reclaiming everything immediately.

shutdownTimeout.description: How long a guest OS is given to shut down cleanly before a stop forces it off (SPEC-025 FR-022). libvirt's shutdown is a request to the guest, not a transition, so a stop that returned when the request was accepted could report success over a still-running guest. A stop is SYNCHRONOUS, so this is also how long an os-stop request can take. Deliberately below upstream's 60s, whose stop is asynchronous and holds no connection: 30s is the default read timeout of gunicorn (Horizon) and most ingresses. A non-positive value is clamped to the 30s default, and anything above 50s is clamped down, because a handler that runs past the server's 60s write deadline has its connection closed with no response written — the stop succeeds and reports nothing.

storageMode.description: Storage backend (primary,fallback comma-separated). rbd,s3 is unsupported: Glance has no RBD backend, so the S3 replica would never be written — use local,s3.

s3.description: S3 / Ceph RGW backend (when storageMode includes s3). Credentials via AWS_* env, not here.

caBundle.description: In-container path to a PEM CA bundle for an internal-CA HTTPS RGW.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS verification (test-only; never true in production).

realMode.description: Privileged real mode (libvirt + host access). Off by default.

hostNetwork.description: Use host networking. Renders dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet on the Lightstack pod and the purge Job, so in-cluster Service names resolve.

libvirtSocketPath.description: Host libvirt socket. Pods mount the directory that holds it (hostPath), so a re-created socket stays reachable. The default lets the binary choose virtqemud-sock, else libvirt-sock, in that directory; any other value is also the socket the binary dials. With secrets.existingSecret the chart renders no config, so the operator's own nova.libvirt_uri must name the same socket. Absolute.

hostStoragePath.description: Node-local data root (hostPath), mounted at the same path in the pod and passed to the binary as state_path. Absolute: libvirtd on the host opens the paths Lightstack writes into the domain XML.

legacyStatePath.description: Pre-rename node-local root to migrate into hostStoragePath once; empty disables.

consoleProxy.description: noVNC console proxy (SPEC-021). Real mode only; deployed alongside Lightstack on the same node.

enabled.description: Deploy the console proxy (real mode only).

repository.description: Proxy image repository. minLength 1 and required so blanking it (--set consoleProxy.image.repository=) is rejected at install: without it the template renders image: ":<tag>", which fails later and less clearly at admission. Matches how image.repository fails closed (FR-018).

tag.description: IMAGE version, not noVNC's — 1.3.0 ships noVNC 1.6.0.

digest.description: Pulled as repository@digest when non-empty, and the tag is then ignored; "" pulls by tag. Never rendered as tag@digest, which Podman and skopeo reject. Defaults to the digest SPEC-021's proxy contract was verified against.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Drop idle console sessions. Must be non-zero: websockify disables the idle timeout at 0, letting an abandoned tab hold a guest console open indefinitely.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext for the proxy. Keeps DAC_OVERRIDE by default: connect() on a guest's console socket needs write permission on a libvirt-qemu-owned socket.

probes.description: Health probes for the console proxy, mirroring the lightstack container's (SPEC-013) but against GET /vnc_lite.html, the client page the proxy serves. Path is fixed; tune timing/thresholds only. A tcpSocket probe is deliberately NOT used: the kernel accepts connections from the listen backlog even when websockify is wedged, so it would report healthy precisely when the console is broken.

readiness.description: readinessProbe -> GET /vnc_lite.html. Failure removes the pod from the Service (no restart).

liveness.description: livenessProbe -> GET /vnc_lite.html. Deliberately slower/more forgiving than readiness: a transient stall should drop the proxy from the Service, not restart it and kill every console session on the node.

applyPrivilegedNamespaceLabel.description: Label the namespace privileged (real mode only; FR-012d).

multiNode.description: Multi-node (DaemonSet) settings. Cross-node behavior is deferred (issue #52).

minProductVersion.description: Advisory-only minimum product-version floor (FR-010). NOT the deployed version — that is image.tag. Not enforced today.

redisUrl.description: Redis URL. In multi-node MUST be a single shared Redis (FR-006a).

dataRetentionPolicy.description: retain keeps all state on uninstall; delete runs the blocking pre-delete purge (SPEC-010).

teardown.description: Teardown hook settings. Effective only when dataRetentionPolicy: delete.

kubectlImage.description: kubectl image for the quiesce/PVC-delete Job. REQUIRED under delete (render-time). Must ship /bin/sh.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the Lightstack container (e.g. AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for the Glance s3 backend). Standard k8s env entries.

probes.description: Kubernetes health probes (SPEC-013), unauthenticated on the identity port: /readyz (DB-gated readiness), /livez (process-up liveness), and the OpenStack /healthcheck alias. Paths are fixed; tune timing/thresholds only. In real mode /readyz also waits until the console socket directory has been prepared once, which takes the host's libvirt answering.

startup.description: startupProbe -> /readyz. failureThreshold x periodSeconds is the boot grace before CrashLoopBackOff: a slow DB connect, and in real mode the host's libvirt answering once. A host where libvirt never answers is restarted.

readiness.description: readinessProbe -> /readyz. Failure removes the pod from the Service (no restart). In real mode it passes only once the console socket directory has been prepared; later libvirt outages do not fail it.

liveness.description: livenessProbe -> /livez (process-up only; never the DB). Failure restarts the container.

drainSeconds.description: Graceful-shutdown drain pause (SPEC-013 FR-009): on SIGTERM Lightstack reports not-ready and waits this many seconds (so the EndpointSlice deregisters) before stopping. 0 disables.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds; MUST exceed drainSeconds plus in-flight request time.
